title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_aws_lambda_in_action_by_danilo_poccia_o3xgh (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_aws_lambda_in_action_by_danilo_poccia_o3xgh' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system is strongly advised.
